description:
The official music video for "Wanted" by Hunter Hayes from the album, Hunter Hayes (Encore) - available now at http://hunterhayes.com/encore

Who’s coming to the Evergreen Tour?! March 25 - April 26… Can’t wait to see you SOON! Get your tickets here: https://www.hunterhayes.com/#tour

Take a look behind the scenes of this video at http://youtu.be/cEvAZVuvPOU

Stay in touch with Hunter Hayes!

Store: http://hunterhayes.com/store
Instagram: http://instagram.com/hunterhayes
Facebook: http://facebook.com/hunterhayes
Twitter: http://twitter.com/hunterhayes
TikTok: http://tiktok.com/@hunterhayes

LYRICS
You know I'd fall apart without you
I don't know how you do what you do
'Cause everything that don't make sense about me

You gotta know you're wanted too

'Cause I wanna wrap you up
Wanna kiss your lips
I wanna make you feel wanted
And I wanna call you mine
Wanna hold your hand forever
And never let you forget it
Yeah, I, I wanna make you feel wanted

Anyone can tell you you're pretty, yeah

And I wanna call you mine

And never let you forget it

Baby, I wanna make you feel wanted

You'll always be wanted
